Includes Programming and Data Structures, Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA), Probability and Statistics, Linear Algebra, Numerical and Complex Analysis, Advanced Calculus, Basic Electronics, Electrical Technology, Solid Mechanics, Structural Analysis, Transportation Engineering, Geomatics, Hydraulics, Basic Mechanics, Engineering Drawing, and Introduction to Civil Engineering.
